legend: Ancient Egyptians are known to have used a large set of symbols ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/782cb89fbe7443d4734af5f2bb9f8d15ac2ace56.png) to write on the walls of the temples. Fafa and Fifa went to one of the temples and found two non-empty words S1 and S2 of equal lengths on the wall of temple written one below the other. Since this temple is very ancient, some symbols from the words were erased. The symbols in the set ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/782cb89fbe7443d4734af5f2bb9f8d15ac2ace56.png) have equal probability for being in the position of any erased symbol.
Fifa challenged Fafa to calculate the probability that S1 is lexicographically greater than S2. Can you help Fafa with this task?

You know that ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/e45165853d1771bbec2e6849b3b55f0021c8d6fa.png), i. e. there were m distinct characters in Egyptians' alphabet, in this problem these characters are denoted by integers from 1 to m in alphabet order. A word x is lexicographically greater than a word y of the same length, if the words are same up to some position, and then the word x has a larger character, than the word y.

We can prove that the probability equals to some fraction ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/8c774283e44990bd22fded6fe64d27b8a23c99ff.png), where P and Q are coprime integers, and ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/9a89b9238145afe8a88be1ad2fb4dc4a5901b1d1.png). Print as the answer the value ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/8919f4faa13b25e67af57ddcb244a740fdc37fab.png), i. e. such a non-negative integer less than 109 + 7, such that ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/b1631491bff462570ddb4b3825cc2b9ca5807ecb.png), where ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/19ed9832b6e4da7413f61a1c23c79068cd8f49d1.png) means that a and b give the same remainders when divided by m.
input: The first line contains two integers n and m (1 ≤ n,  m ≤ 105) — the length of each of the two words and the size of the alphabet ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/782cb89fbe7443d4734af5f2bb9f8d15ac2ace56.png), respectively.
The second line contains n integers a1, a2, ..., an (0 ≤ ai ≤ m) — the symbols of S1. If ai = 0, then the symbol at position i was erased.
The third line contains n integers representing S2 with the same format as S1.
output: Print the value ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/57394b93f524f97ade9fb74b302ba6833a1081c6.png), where P and Q are coprime and ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/8c774283e44990bd22fded6fe64d27b8a23c99ff.png) is the answer to the problem.
note: In the first sample, the first word can be converted into (1) or (2). The second option is the only one that will make it lexicographically larger than the second word. So, the answer to the problem will be ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/a762254bc6d3a2cc6ae07485c1de945962e7e524.png), that is 500000004, because ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/cbff288b4c38669aa9b8013ee25b8dde80420841.png).

In the second example, there is no replacement for the zero in the second word that will make the first one lexicographically larger. So, the answer to the problem is ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/a468ab19fec68399601f37993805846b7dd342ad.png), that is 0.

input.ai: 第一行包含两个整数 n 和 m(1 ≤ n，  m ≤ 105)，分别表示两个单词的长度和字母表的大小 ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/782cb89fbe7443d4734af5f2bb9f8d15ac2ace56.png)。
第二行包含 n 个整数 a1, a2, ..., an（0 ≤ ai ≤ m），表示 S1 中的符号。如果 ai = 0，则位置 i 上的符号已被擦除。
第三行包含按与 S1 相同格式表示 S2 的 n 个整数。

output.ai: 输出 ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/57394b93f524f97ade9fb74b302ba6833a1081c6.png) 的值，其中 P 和 Q 互质，且 ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/8c774283e44990bd22fded6fe64d27b8a23c99ff.png) 是该问题的答案。

note.ai: 在第一个样例中，第一个单词可以转换成 (1) 或 (2)。只有第二种方案能使其字典序大于第二个单词。因此，该问题的答案是 ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/a762254bc6d3a2cc6ae07485c1de945962e7e524.png)，即 500000004，因为 ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/cbff288b4c38669aa9b8013ee25b8dde80420841.png)。
在第二个样例中，无论如何替换第二个单词中的 0，都无法使第一个单词的字典序更大。因此，该问题的答案是 ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/a468ab19fec68399601f37993805846b7dd342ad.png)，即 0。

legend.ai: 众所周知，古埃及人使用一组大型符号 ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/782cb89fbe7443d4734af5f2bb9f8d15ac2ace56.png) 在神庙的墙壁上书写。Fafa 和 Fifa 来到其中一座神庙，在墙上发现了两个长度相等的非空单词 S1 和 S2，它们在墙上上下排列。由于这座神庙非常古老，单词中的一些符号已经被擦除。集合 ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/782cb89fbe7443d4734af5f2bb9f8d15ac2ace56.png) 中的符号出现在任意一个被擦除位置的概率相同。
Fifa 挑战 Fafa 计算 S1 按字典序大于 S2 的概率。你能帮助 Fafa 完成这项任务吗？

已知 ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/e45165853d1771bbec2e6849b3b55f0021c8d6fa.png)，也就是说，埃及人的字母表中有 m 个互不相同的字符。在本题中，这些字符按照字母顺序用 1 到 m 的整数表示。对于长度相同的单词 x 和 y，如果两个单词在某个位置之前完全相同，而在该位置 x 中的字符大于 y 中的字符，则称单词 x 按字典序大于单词 y。

可以证明，该概率等于某个分数 ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/8c774283e44990bd22fded6fe64d27b8a23c99ff.png)，其中 P 和 Q 是互质整数，并且 ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/9a89b9238145afe8a88be1ad2fb4dc4a5901b1d1.png)。请输出 ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/8919f4faa13b25e67af57ddcb244a740fdc37fab.png) 的值，也就是小于 109 + 7 的非负整数，使得 ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/b1631491bff462570ddb4b3825cc2b9ca5807ecb.png)，其中 ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/19ed9832b6e4da7413f61a1c23c79068cd8f49d1.png) 表示 a 和 b 除以 m 时得到相同的余数。

titleZh.ai: D. Fafa 和古老的字母表
